lines.text: Why does a photo get blurry when you zoom in?
It's usually a raster image: a fixed grid of tiny coloured squares called pixels.
Zoom in, and each pixel just gets bigger, so edges turn into steps.
Many apps smooth those blocks, which looks blurry.
A vector logo stores shapes as points and curves, so it's redrawn sharply at any size.
Zooming can't add detail a photo never captured.
